scope: Hub-only F6 Linux ARM64 container input immutability and exact-export runtime-evidence preparation; no image build, container, VM, persistent service, final artifact, runtime lifecycle, release, tag, signing, CI or publication; one ephemeral loopback TLS unit-test listener was created and fully stopped

official_base_resolution.method: Authenticated Docker Registry HTTP API V2 HEAD/GET of the official library tag with OCI/Docker index media types, followed by ARM64 child-manifest and config readback; bearer token was neither printed nor retained
official_base_resolution.claim_limit: The pinned multi-platform index digests preserve ordinary platform selection, but only their Linux ARM64 children were inspected and only Linux ARM64 runtime acceptance is planned.

immutable_build_design.base_selection: Both FROM inputs retain their descriptive official tags and bind the exact OCI index digest.
immutable_build_design.runtime_package_manager: absent; the runtime stage has no RUN instruction and performs no apt, apk, dnf, yum, curl or wget operation
immutable_build_design.public_tls_roots: The digest-pinned Rust builder supplies /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt to the digest-pinned Debian runtime, and SSL_CERT_FILE binds Hub outbound TLS clients to that copied bundle.
immutable_build_design.build_context: Git metadata, local config.toml, TLS material, private-key/certificate extensions and target cache are excluded; Dockerfile COPY inputs remain explicit, including both production compile-time embedded files.
immutable_build_design.dependency_binding: cargo build --locked uses the tracked Cargo.lock registry package versions and checksums; registry availability is not a claim of vendored/offline construction.
immutable_build_design.runtime_identity: normal Hub uses numeric UID/GID 10001, read-only root filesystem, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, private tmpfs, loopback host port and explicit config/TLS/data mounts; the one-shot volume initializer drops all capabilities then adds only CHOWN, FOWNER and DAC_OVERRIDE and verifies 10001:10001/0700
immutable_build_design.multi_platform_limit: No platform is forced in the source Compose file; only the recorded Linux ARM64 child is in this evidence scope.

initial_findings.finding: The Docker builder context omitted the production SQL fixture embedded by updates_delivery.rs, so an image build could not compile.
initial_findings.closure: Dockerfile now copies the exact fixture; the new builder-COPY-only temporary context test also exposed and closed the pre-existing omitted macOS plist include, then compiled the production binary offline.

initial_findings.finding: The healthcheck validated TLS against 127.0.0.1 while the ordinary documentation issued a hostname certificate.
initial_findings.closure: Compose now requires the certificate/public_url DNS name; the Hub probe validates that name while resolving it only to loopback. A real local TLS test accepts the matching SAN and rejects a mismatched name.

initial_findings.finding: The all-capabilities-dropped Hub service could not perform root volume ownership preparation.
initial_findings.closure: Volume preparation is a distinct one-shot read-only-root service that drops all caps, adds only CHOWN/FOWNER/DAC_OVERRIDE, and fails unless stat reads 10001:10001:700; normal Hub remains cap_drop ALL.

initial_findings.finding: The Docker build context did not mirror private key and certificate extension exclusions.
initial_findings.closure: *.key, *.pem, *.p12 and *.pfx are excluded and asserted by the static test.
